description: Warm and humid weather favors bacterial leaf blight - especially after typhoons and heavy rain
source: IRRI rice biotic stress manual: 25-34 C and humidity above 70% (no duration stated so 2 days; daily mean humidity used)

description: Hot and very humid days favor sheath blight
source: TNAU Agritech rice diseases (citing IRRI): 28-32 C and 96-100% humidity (no duration stated so 2 days)

description: Warm and very humid days favor Cercospora leaf spot on mungbean
source: Review in Sarhad J. / ResearchersLinks - Unveiling the factors affecting leaf spot disease in mungbean: 25-30 C and 90-100% humidity (no duration stated so 2 days)

description: Warm and very humid weather favors gray leaf spot
source: Crop Protection Network - Gray leaf spot of corn: warm (80s F) and humidity above 90% for 12+ hours (daily mean humidity used)

description: Several warm and humid days in a row favor frogeye leaf spot
source: NC State Extension - Frogeye leaf spot of soybean: 25-30 C and humidity above 90%; Crop Protection Network: several overcast days favor it
